stem.en: The Earth's interior heat flow is split like this: crust 24, upper mantle 22, lower mantle 32 and core 22 per cent. Which statement is correct?

text.en: The core gives a bigger share than the crust

feedback.en: No. The core gives 22 per cent and the crust gives 24.

text.en: The crust gives the biggest share of all

feedback.en: No. The lower mantle gives 32 per cent, more than the crust's 24.

text.en: The two mantle parts give over half

feedback.en: Yes. 22 + 32 = 54 per cent, which is more than half.

text.en: All four parts give about the same share

feedback.en: No. The shares run from 22 to 32 per cent, so they differ.

explanation.en: Add the two parts of the mantle: 22 + 32 = 54 per cent. That is more than the crust and core together, which give 46 per cent. The lower mantle alone has the largest single share.

hints.en: Which two shares belong to the mantle?
Add them. Is the total more than 50?
